5.arabic: أَرَحْتُ أَطُوْفُ بَيْنَ الْخَلْقِ أَهْتِفُ بِاسْمِكَ النَّظِرِ
5.latin: Arahtu athuufu bainal khalqi ahtifu bismikan nadhiri

en.name: I Called Out With Your Guidance

text.1: I called out with your gentle guidance,
text.2: Upon the universes for all time,
text.3: I called out with your exalted light,
text.4: Illuminating time like the full moon,
text.5: I went wandering among creation, calling out your radiant name,
text.6: And I declare among the multitudes of people,
text.7: That you are the source of goodness.

text.1: Aku berseru dengan petunjukmu yang lembut,
text.2: Di atas seluruh alam semesta sepanjang masa,
text.3: Aku berseru dengan cahayamu yang agung,
text.5: Aku berkeliling di antara makhluk, menyerukan namamu yang berseri,
text.6: Dan aku umumkan di tengah kerumunan manusia,
